note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alate, soldier and both worker morphs are described; synonyms, literature citations, distribution, figure numbers and the synonymy discussion with distans are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to dark reddish brown; antennae and body milky white to straw yellow; mandibles blackish brown, yellowish brown at the base. Pilosity sparse on the head, denser on the body. Body length 5.30–7.45 mm. Head capsule large, suboblong-oval, narrowed anteriorly; 1.89–2.70 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.45–2.15 mm maximum width. Antennae 16–17-segmented; with 16 segments, segment 3 either subequal to or slightly longer than segment 2 and subdivided; with 17 segments, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, or subequal to segments 4 and 5, or shortest. Labrum triangular, ligulate, apex pointed. Mandibles robust, half the head length or slightly more; 1.19–1.38 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.50–0.60; tips slightly incurved. Left mandible with a minute lateral tooth basad of the middle third; tooth 0.70–0.90 mm from the tip; ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.58–0.65. Right mandible toothless or with a minute tooth near the base. Postmentum subrectangular; 1.15–1.70 mm long, 0.62–0.90 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin strongly emarginate; 0.60–0.93 mm long, 1.05–1.65 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellowish brown; antennae, thorax and legs pale yellow; body nearly white to pale yellow. Pilosity moderate on head and body. Body length 4.70–5.80 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; 1.50–1.75 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.60–1.80 mm maximum width. Antennae 17–19-segmented; with 17 segments, segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 5 shortest; with 18 or 19 segments, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins both weakly notched; 0.50–0.60 mm long, 0.85–1.20 mm wide. Minor worker: very rare, identical to the major worker except in smaller size and 17-segmented antennae (segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 5 shortest); body length 3.0–3.6 mm, 0.90–0.95 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.08–1.15 mm maximum head width, pronotum 0.48–0.50 mm long, 0.75–0.78 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown with a reddish tinge to chestnut brown; antennae and postclypeus pale brown; pronotum concolorous with the head capsule, with a pale T-shaped mark at the middle and a shoulder spot on each side; wings pale yellowish brown; abdominal tergites chestnut, sternites pale brown. Pilosity dense on head and body. Body length 26.5–30.5 mm with wings, 10.50–14.00 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long; 2.0–2.40 mm long to base of mandibles, 2.50–2.80 mm wide including compound eyes. Fontanelle small, punctiform, slightly raised, surrounded by a slightly depressed and paler area. Compound eyes subcircular; maximum diameter 0.58–0.65 mm, minimum diameter 0.55–0.60 mm. Ocelli round to suboval, separated from the compound eye by their long diameter or slightly more (long diameter 0.20–0.27 mm, short diameter 0.15–0.20 mm, eye-ocellus distance 0.23–0.30 mm). Antennae 18–19-segmented; segments 3, 4 and 5 either subequal with slight variation, segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, less than half as long as wide; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Pronotum trapezoidal, narrower than the head capsule including eyes; 1.0–1.3 mm long, 2.0–2.50 mm wide; anterior margin with a shallow median notch, posterior margin deeply notched. Wings smoky pale brown; fore wing 25.0–27.50 mm long, hind wing 24.0–25.0 mm long; wing-membrane microstructure consisting of fine, wavy obesus-type cuticular rods; radial trace separating from the radius at about the apical third.
